integrity: The principal asserted improvement is an exponentially accurate finite-sample expected-area identity; accompanying distributional statements use acknowledged pre-existing joint Poisson-process convergence and a directly proved polygonal cap identity. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed convex planar polygons with no collinear consecutive edges with positive side lengths; independent arclength-uniform samples; no simultaneous growing-side-count limit. Explicit finite-mean remainder is exponentially bounded but its sharp exponent is not claimed. Earlier use of local Poisson limits is acknowledged. Independent validation not performed.
title: An exponentially accurate perimeter–angle mean law for random boundary hulls
